name: Okra extract
description: Okra extract (CAS 91723-07-8 ), derived from the pods of Abelmoschus esculentus, delivers concentrated mucilaginous polysaccharides and bioactive compounds used across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical manufacturing. It functions primarily as a natural humectant, texture modifier, and flavoring agent in finished formulations. In food and beverage production, it acts as a natural thickener and flavor contributor. This extract is ideal for soups, sauces, and functional food products where clean-label viscosity solutions are preferred. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into moisturizing creams, serums, and hair care products. Its film-forming and water-retention properties support skin hydration claims. In nutraceutical and dietary supplement manufacturing, it supplies a recognized source of polyphenols, flavonoids, and dietary fiber. These components are essential for encapsulated or powdered supplement formats. Functional beverage developers also use it as a botanical flavoring and nutritional additive targeting digestive wellness positioning. Okra extract is commercially available as a spray-dried powder and liquid extract. Dry forms are the most common for supplement and food applications, ensuring stability and ease of handling during production. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications. Some suppliers offer standardized polysaccharide or polyphenol content to meet specific formulation requirements and industry benchmarks. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram quantities to bulk sacks suited for industrial procurement volumes.
